decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits squarely within the firm's cardboard display know-how, so it can read early results and refine the design in-house.
A shelf display with a pegboard back is a small variation on the firm's core competence, so its own R&D and design staff can absorb customer feedback and improve it.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a core format that builds directly on existing knowledge and production capacity.
The eighth-pallet display extends a familiar format to smaller placements, where the firm can apply its existing expertise effectively.
Wood is less tied to the firm's paper-based knowledge base, which makes learning harder, but it adds value to the one-stop offer and is worth keeping for now while results are monitored.
The media-product display uses the firm's familiar cardboard know-how, though demand from the media segment may be shrinking, so it carries somewhat more risk.
